priorityList: Summon your pet or use Grimoire of Sacrifice before combat starts.
Cast Haunt on cooldown for both Cleave and AoE encounters.
Cast Seed of Corruption if Wither is not ticking or is refreshable on your primary targets.
Use Dark Harvest on cooldown, ideally when dots are fully applied.
Maintain Agony on all available targets, prioritizing refreshing those with less than 5 seconds remaining.
Summon Darkglare as your primary offensive cooldown.
Cast Malevolence immediately after summoning your Darkglare or while it is active.
In 2-target Cleave, manually refresh Wither if it is refreshable and no Seed of Corruption is currently being cast.
Cast Unstable Affliction if you have the Shard Instability proc.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities when your major cooldowns (Darkglare and Malevolence) are active.
Spend Soul Shards on Seed of Corruption for AoE damage, especially if talented into Sow the Seeds and Patient Zero.
Cast Unstable Affliction in Cleave situations if you have high Soul Shards or the Cascading Calamity buff is expiring.
Use Malefic Grasp (or Drain Soul/Shadow Bolt) if your Darkglare is about to expire to maximize its value.
Cast Malefic Grasp, Drain Soul, or Shadow Bolt when you have Nightfall procs available.
Use Shadow Bolt or Drain Soul as a filler when all dots are maintained and no other priority actions are available.
